Plot an age-model check: the de-chirped maps, the rate corrections the cycles ask for and the flagged intervals

Source: R/check_agemodel.R
plot_agemodel_check.Rd

Plot an age-model check: the de-chirped maps, the rate corrections the cycles ask for and the flagged intervals

Usage

plot_agemodel_check(
  x,
  transforms = names(x$dechirped),
  view = c("tuned", "depth"),
  rate_unit = c(1, "depth units / kyr"),
  main = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Age-model check to plot: the output of check_agemodel (an object of class wr_agemodel_check). Required, no default.

transforms

De-chirped maps to show, one panel each (character vector, a subset of names(x$dechirped), i.e. of the transforms used in check_agemodel). Default=names(x$dechirped) (all computed maps).

view

Horizontal axis of the plots (character): "tuned" shows the maps in the time of the track (kyr), where the astronomical cycles should be horizontal lines; "depth" shows them mapped back to depth. Default=c("tuned", "depth"), i.e. "tuned".

rate_unit

Factor and label of the rate axis, as a vector c(factor, label), e.g. c(100, "cm/kyr"). In the current version it has no effect on the plot (the correction panel shows a dimensionless correction factor). Default=c(1, "depth units / kyr").

main

Title of the top (proxy) panel (character); NULL uses a default title. Default=NULL.

...

Further arguments passed to plot_dechirped for the map panels (e.g. palette, level, scale, outline_lwd, ylab); style, show and main are set by this function.

Value

Invisibly x.
